questions.question: Who played Jack Dawson in Titanic?
questions.note: Kate Winslet played Rose; they were reunited on-screen in Revolutionary Road.

questions.question: Who played the title character in Forrest Gump?
questions.note: Hanks won Best Actor; the film also won Best Picture.

questions.question: Who played Tony Stark / Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.note: The role that relaunched his career, starting with Iron Man in 2008.

questions.question: Who played Hermione Granger in the Harry Potter films?
questions.note: Daniel Radcliffe is Harry; Rupert Grint is Ron.

questions.question: Who starred as Eliza Doolittle in the 1964 film My Fair Lady?
questions.note: Julie Andrews originated the role on stage and won an Oscar the same year for Mary Poppins.

questions.question: Who played the Joker in The Dark Knight?
questions.note: A posthumous Best Supporting Actor Oscar.

questions.question: Who played Clarice Starling in The Silence of the Lambs?
questions.note: Opposite Anthony Hopkins as Hannibal Lecter; the film swept the “Big Five” Oscars.

questions.question: Who played Neo in The Matrix?
questions.note: Laurence Fishburne played Morpheus; Carrie-Anne Moss played Trinity.

questions.question: Who played the title role in Erin Brockovich?
questions.note: She won Best Actress; the film is based on a real legal case.

questions.question: Who played James Bond in the first official Bond film, Dr. No?
questions.note: Connery was the first of the Eon series; Lazenby did only On Her Majesty’s Secret Service.
